source: Starting point, not official. One patch for both songs: same guitarists (Gotoh rhythm, Kita lead), standard tuning, key of E, fast 4/4 (175 and 180 BPM), distortion mostly from the amp (Wikipedia: Hokai Amplifier, Rewrite). Kita's past amps: Marshall JCM900 + 1960A (ja.wikipedia), so MS 800 stands in. A G2X user answer for Rewrite names a Les Paul, a Fender-type tube amp and a Tube Screamer, no numbers (Yahoo Chiebukuro). No session gear for 2002-2004 is documented: every value is an estimate. For Rewrite, try a little less amp gain and less bass.
